items.title: Sammy Penn Interview, 1960-04-21
items.q: The interviewee addresses the interviewer as 'Mr. Bill' (Bill Russell). There is no mention of a personal or professional relationship between Sammy Penn and Bill Russell in the text.

ctx.x: Do you remember where you got your first drums, what they were like?
Well, the first drums that I played on, Mr. Bill, it was a tub, an ordinary tub.
